statement: A disruptive operation-ledger self-move that observes incumbents publishes one durable PENDING intent before waiting, preventing later dependent admissions from overtaking it; physical dispatch remains parked until typed authoritative owner visibility proves the ledger idle, and unreadable visibility canonically retries. Existing operation-owner recovery, run-20 exclusivity, run-22 quorum spread, emergency ADD, remove safety, topology fences, numeric budgets, and the 60-second five-node bar remain unchanged. Red-on-revert explicitly observes the legacy refusal, admits later newcomers while the writer is unregistered, and fails the named no-overtake assertion; fixed bytes pass that proof and the fairness model.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The waiting turn remains the existing durable replica-operation intent under the canonical operation-owner lifecycle; no coordinator-local waiter, TTL, secondary queue, or new metadata authority is allowed.

Physical self-move dispatch remains fail-closed until an authoritative incomplete-operation observation proves no other live conflict; unreadable or deferred visibility keeps the PENDING intent parked on canonical retry.
Keep run-20 exclusive physical serialization, later-dependent deferral, run-22 quorum-spread ordering, and the emergency ADD exemption unchanged.
Cancellation, transfer, retry, timeout, and cleanup reuse canonical operation-owner lease and reaper transitions; no raw age check deletes or bypasses a waiter.
The fixed TLA+ contract must distinguish the durable waiting-writer turn from the admission-only starvation mutant, and npm run model:contracts must pass.

On base bytes the focused test must explicitly observe legacy writer refusal, successfully admit later newcomers while no waiter is registered, and fail the named no-overtake assertion; fixed bytes must reject the same newcomers and retain incumbent, unreadable-visibility, and idle-release checks.
Do not alter formation timeouts, polling or retry cadence, numeric budgets, workload, cluster size, activation predicates, remove safety, topology fences, or GCP ordering.
After deterministic proof, exact source verification, and checkpoint, run the unchanged dedicated five-node GCP formation/profile gate once and stop on its first red boundary.
